caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear glass bottle with a decorative stopper. The bottle is vertically oriented and occupies the center of the composition, surrounded by a blank background bordered by a thin line. The stopper is round with a small knob at the top and a circular indentation in the middle. Below the stopper, the neck of the bottle features three bands with faceted, beaded, or hobnail-like decorative patterns, alternating with smooth rings. The shoulder of the bottle is wide and tapers to the base, decorated with a series of elongated oval or teardrop-shaped facets radiating from the neck downwards. The main body of the bottle, which is cylindrical, is adorned with evenly spaced vertical cuts or grooves encircling the lower half. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray with fine pencil lines and shading to suggest transparency and depth, imitating the reflective qualities of cut glass.
title: Clear Glass Decanter
